introSmall: Build a tower! Big blocks go at the bottom. Small blocks go on top.
introBig: Build a tall tower, from the biggest block to the smallest. Count the squares!
instructions: Biggest at the bottom! Drag or tap a block.
tooBig: Oops! That block is too big. A big block can't sit on a small one.
fell: Oh no, the tower fell! A big block can't sit on a small one. Let's build it again.
